purpose: Bound the remaining early-inspiral aligned-spin same-state physical gap with the existing source-backed native Hamiltonian and flux choices.
method: Select each target by the five-point orbital frequency on the 0.125 M public dynamics grid; compare native field and flux torque at the public state at that exact time on both output grids. The public torque is a five-point derivative of sampled pphi, not a direct public flux evaluation.
